profile.headline: Software Engineer II | Java, Spring Boot, SQL
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with over 4 years of professional experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications. My expertise is primarily in backend development, with a focus on Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, SQL, and cloud technologies such as AWS.

Throughout my career, I've contributed to modernizing legacy systems, improving application performance, designing efficient database solutions, and building reliable services that support complex business operations. I have hands-on experience with microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud-native application development.

I hold a Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of Nebraska–Lincoln and have built my software engineering career through continuous learning, practical experience, and solving real-world technical challenges.
I'm passionate about building high-quality software, exploring emerging technologies, and collaborating with teams to develop innovative solutions that deliver meaningful business value.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Modernized a legacy Java invoicing platform serving 50,000+ clients monthly by redesigning database schemas, refactoring REST APIs, and introducing in-memory caching, cutting page load times from ~15 seconds to under 1 second and improving overall system scalability.
 
Owned the end-to-end design and build of a new escrow account management service by integrating with a third-party invoicing system and implementing a Spring Scheduler-driven billing engine, automating account creation and recurring invoice generation across 5 billing cycles and eliminating manual data-entry errors.
 
Improved operational reliability for the invoicing platform by building maker-checker approval workflows and authoring end-to-end Cucumber/BDD test suites, reducing regression risk and giving Ops a self-service way to review and approve invoice actions before they reach clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Hibernate · Java · Swagger API · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Boot · SQL · Cucumber · GitHub Copilot · Claude Code · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Extended Verizon's large-scale SPM platform by designing and implementing new business features on top of existing APIs as part of the FUZE team, supporting evolving product and business requirements.
 
Improved API maintainability and performance through structured refactoring and modular design, supporting a more reliable enterprise-scale service platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Swagger API · Spring Boot · SQL · REST APIs

positions.title: Java Engineer
positions.description:
Built event-driven data pipelines for Walmart's customer segmentation team by capturing client- and server-side eCommerce activity and publishing ~50 promotional events/day via an ad hoc CSV-to-Kafka integration, enabling targeted audience lists for promotional campaigns.
 
Enabled third-party marketing integrations by designing complex SQL queries that generated hashed customer datasets from shopping event data, powering targeted email campaigns through third-party APIs.
 
Strengthened code quality and system reliability by writing Java and React unit tests across 3 codebases and participating in weekly on-call rotations, achieving 80%+ test coverage while maintaining website stability.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Hadoop · React.js · Spring Boot · SQL · Go (Programming Language) · Apache Kafka · Python (Programming Language) · Grafana · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer Trainee
positions.description:
Built a foundation in professional software engineering by completing an intensive 10-week program covering 20+ engineering concepts with no prior industry experience, building 4 full-stack Java applications individually and in teams.
 
Demonstrated readiness for client-facing engineering work by earning contract placement with 3 of Revature's top enterprise clients based on training performance.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Boot · SQL · REST APIs
